lens: A genuinely new Wednesday lead: JBS moved to buy in the ~18% of Pilgrim's Pride it doesn't own (Citi), and Francisco Partners agreed to take Weave private at $7.40/share (Jefferies) — while Huntsman/Olin counts down to its Aug 25 votes (Citi, Morgan Stanley, Lazard). The tape rebounded (VIX -4.5%) but bulge-bracket bank stocks slipped as advisory boutiques rallied, Lazard +4.5%.

stories.headline: JBS proposes to buy in the ~18% of Pilgrim's Pride it doesn't own via a 2.086-share exchange; Citi advises JBS
stories.why_it_matters: JBS N.V. (NYSE: JBS) submitted a non-binding proposal on Aug 18 to acquire all Pilgrim's Pride (NASDAQ: PPC) shares it does not already own — JBS holds ~82% — at a fixed 2.086 JBS Class A shares per PPC share (implied ~$28.50/PPC share versus Aug 18 closes of JBS $13.66 and PPC $28.49). Per JBS's 8-K, Citi is serving as financial adviser to JBS (White & Case legal). A controlling-shareholder buy-in runs special-committee, fairness-opinion and majority-of-minority workstreams: the deal is conditioned on approval by a to-be-appointed special committee of independent, disinterested PPC directors — which will retain its OWN independent legal and financial advisers — and on a majority of votes cast by unaffiliated PPC holders. On close, PPC would delist from Nasdaq.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Citi (JBS) now, and watch for PPC's special committee to name its own independent financial adviser — a second, sell-side mandate on the same deal. A majority-of-minority take-in runs special-committee diligence, fairness-opinion and proxy workstreams a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: JBS submits non-binding proposal for PPC minority (2.086x exchange ratio)
PPC special committee to be appointed and retain independent advisers

stories.source: SEC EDGAR — JBS N.V. 8-K (EX-99.2, press release)

stories.headline: Francisco Partners to take Weave Communications private at $7.40/share (~$650M); Jefferies advises Weave
stories.why_it_matters: Weave Communications (NYSE: WEAV), a SaaS customer-communications platform for healthcare and small-business practices, agreed on Aug 18 to be taken private by Francisco Partners for $7.40 per share in cash (~$650M equity value; guaranteed by Francisco Partners VII funds). Per the merger agreement (filed Aug 19), Weave's Board received the written fairness opinion of Jefferies LLC, its financial adviser; the agreement carries a $22.77M company termination fee and a $39.03M parent termination fee. A sponsor take-private of a public software company runs fiduciary-out/go-shop, committed-financing and shareholder-vote workstreams — and it is a fresh sell-side mandate for Jefferies, which has been the advisory laggard among the pure-plays this month.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Jefferies (Weave) — a $7.40/share software take-private runs fiduciary-out, financing and proxy diligence a secure room organizes through close.

deal_clock.event: Weave agrees to $7.40/share all-cash take-private by Francisco Partners

stories.headline: Huntsman/Olin all-stock merger heads into its Aug 25 shareholder votes; Citi and Morgan Stanley advise Huntsman, Lazard advises Olin
